---
title: About
---

Welcome! I am a Visiting Researcher with the <a href="https://www.scripts-berlin.eu/" target="_blank">SCRIPTS Cluster of Excellence</a> based at Freie Universität Berlin. I recently completed my PhD in Politics and International Relations at <a href="https://www.ucd.ie/spire/" target="_blank">University College Dublin</a> and am currently on the academic job market. My research is focused on authoritarian information manipulation. I use mixed methods, including computational text analysis, survey experiments, and semi-structured interviews, to study forms of authoritarian information control, and its effects and consequences. My interest in these issues is informed by a decade-long career as a journalist and foreign correspondent for the Singaporean public broadcaster, <a href="https://www.channelnewsasia.com/international" target="_blank">Channel NewsAsia</a>. My research has been supported by <a href="https://www.researchireland.ie/" target="_blank">Research Ireland</a>, where I am a Government of Ireland Postgraduate Scholar (2022-2026), and the <a href="https://www.tfd.org.tw/en/index" target="_blank">Taiwan Foundation for Democracy</a>, where I was a Dissertation Fellow in 2024.
